logger.doc:name: Log KYC Request
logger.message: Process API: Processing KYC request for account: #[payload.account]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var birthYear = payload.Birthday splitBy "-" then $[2] as Number var currentYear = now() as String {format: "yyyy"} as Number var age = currentYear - birthYear var isValidAge = age >= 18 var isValidCurrency = payload.currency == "PHP" or payload.currency == "USD" or payload.currency == "EUR" var isValidAmount = payload.amount > 0 --- if (isValidAge and isValidCurrency and isValidAmount) { "response code": 200, "response message": "Successful kyc" } else { "response code": 422, "response message": "Business validation failed" }

logger.doc:name: Log KYC Response
logger.message: Process API: KYC business validation completed
